title: Group Shifted Strings
description:
Perform the following shift operations on a string:

Right shift: Replace every letter with the successive letter of the English alphabet, where 'z' is replaced by 'a'. For example, "abc" can be right-shifted to "bcd" or "xyz" can be right-shifted to "yza".
Left shift: Replace every letter with the preceding letter of the English alphabet, where 'a' is replaced by 'z'. For example, "bcd" can be left-shifted to "abc" or "yza" can be left-shifted to "xyz".

We can keep shifting the string in both directions to form an endless shifting sequence.

For example, shift "abc" to form the sequence: ... <-> "abc" <-> "bcd" <-> ... <-> "xyz" <-> "yza" <-> .... <-> "zab" <-> "abc" <-> ...

You are given an array of strings strings, group together all strings[i] that belong to the same shifting sequence. You may return the answer in any order.
 
Example 1:

Input: strings = ["abc","bcd","acef","xyz","az","ba","a","z"]
Output: [["acef"],["a","z"],["abc","bcd","xyz"],["az","ba"]]

Example 2:

Input: strings = ["a"]
Output: [["a"]]

 
Constraints:

1 <= strings.length <= 200
1 <= strings[i].length <= 50
strings[i] consists of lowercase English letters.

def check(candidate):
    assert sorted(sorted(group) for group in candidate(['abc','bcd','acef','xyz','az','ba','a','z'])) == sorted(sorted(group) for group in [['abc','bcd','xyz'],['acef'],['az','ba'],['a','z']])
    assert sorted(sorted(group) for group in candidate(['a'])) == [['a']]
    assert sorted(sorted(group) for group in candidate(['ab','bc','cd','de'])) == [['ab','bc','cd','de']]
    assert sorted(sorted(group) for group in candidate(['az','yx','ba'])) == sorted(sorted(group) for group in [['az','ba','yx']])
    assert sorted(sorted(group) for group in candidate(['abc','def','ghi','ad'])) == sorted(sorted(group) for group in [['abc','def','ghi'],['ad']])
    assert sorted(sorted(group) for group in candidate(['aa','bb','zz','ab'])) == sorted(sorted(group) for group in [['aa','bb','zz'],['ab']])
    assert sorted(sorted(group) for group in candidate(['nop','opq','p'])) == sorted(sorted(group) for group in [['nop','opq'],['p']])
    assert sorted(sorted(group) for group in candidate(['mno','abc','bcd','za'])) == sorted(sorted(group) for group in [['mno','abc','bcd'],['za']])
